```{r}
library(survival)
```

C-index
```{r}
library(survival)

set.seed(42)

# Split into training and test sets
n <- nrow(lung)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = 0.7 * n)
train_data <- lung[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- lung[-train_idx, ]

# Fit Cox model on training data
cox_model <- coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex, data = train_data)

# Predict on independent test set
lp_test <- predict(cox_model, newdata = test_data, type = "lp")

# Compute concordance index on the test set
cindex <- concordance(Surv(test_data$time,
                           test_data$status) ~ lp_test)

# Output
cindex
cat("Test-set C-index:", round(cindex$concordance, 3), "\n")

```

Performance
```{r}
# Create risk groups based on predicted risk
lung$risk <- cut(predict(cox_model), breaks=quantile(predict(cox_model), probs=0:3/3),
                 labels=c("Low", "Medium", "High"), include.lowest=TRUE)

# Plot Kaplan-Meier survival curves by risk group
library(survminer)
ggsurvplot(survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ risk, data=lung),
           data=lung, pval=TRUE, risk.table=TRUE)
```

Random forest
```{r}
library(survival)
library(randomForestSRC)
library(survcomp)

set.seed(42)

# 1) Split into training (70%) and test (30%)
n <- nrow(lung)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = 0.7 * n)
train_data <- lung[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- lung[-train_idx, ]

# 2) Fit RSF on the training data
# - RSF handles missing values internally; we set na.action="na.impute" explicitly for clarity.
rsf_model <- rfsrc(
  Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex,
  data = train_data,
  ntree = 1000,          # more trees -> stabler predictions
  nodesize = 15,         # small default is fine; tune if you like
  nsplit = 10            # randomized splits; speeds up
)

# 3) Predict on the independent test set
#    This returns survival info over a time grid for each test subject.
pred_test <- predict(rsf_model, newdata = test_data)

# 4) Turn the prediction into a single risk score per subject
#    Use the cumulative hazard at the last time point as a scalar risk (higher = riskier).
risk_test <- pred_test$chf
risk_test <- risk_test[, ncol(risk_test), "condCHF.1"]

# 5) Build Surv() for the test set and compute the C-index
#    survcomp::concordance.index expects event as 0/1 (1=event). The lung dataset uses 1=censored, 2=event,
#    so we recode to 0/1 explicitly.
event_test <- as.integer(test_data$status == 2)

c_rsf <- concordance.index(
  x = risk_test,
  surv.time  = test_data$time,
  surv.event = event_test
)

c_rsf$c.index

```

Lasso and elastic net
```{r}
library(survival)
library(glmnet)
library(survcomp)

set.seed(42)

# 1️⃣ Recode event variable: 1 = event, 0 = censored
lung$status <- ifelse(lung$status == 2, 1, 0)

# 2️⃣ Split into training and test sets
n <- nrow(lung)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = 0.7 * n)
train_data <- lung[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- lung[-train_idx, ]

# 3️⃣ Prepare model matrices (glmnet needs x matrix, y Surv object)
x_train <- model.matrix(~ age + sex, data = train_data)[, -1] # remove intercept
y_train <- Surv(train_data$time, train_data$status)

x_test  <- model.matrix(~ age + sex, data = test_data)[, -1]

# 4️⃣ Fit penalized Cox model with cross-validation to choose lambda
fit_glmnet <- cv.glmnet(x_train, y_train, family = "cox", alpha = 1) # alpha=1 = Lasso

# 5️⃣ Predict linear predictor (risk score) on test set
lp_glmnet <- predict(fit_glmnet, newx = x_test, s = "lambda.min", type = "link")[,1]

# 6️⃣ Compute concordance index on the test set
c_glmnet <- concordance.index(
  x = lp_glmnet,
  surv.time  = test_data$time,
  surv.event = test_data$status
)

c_glmnet$c.index

### ELASTIC NET
fit_enet <- cv.glmnet(x_train, y_train, family = "cox", alpha = 0.5)  # 0.5 = equal mix
lp_enet <- predict(fit_enet, newx = x_test, s = "lambda.min", type = "link")[,1]
c_enet <- concordance.index(lp_enet, surv.time = test_data$time, surv.event = test_data$status)
c_enet$c.index

```

Cox boosting
```{r}
library(survival)
library(gbm)
library(survcomp)

set.seed(42)

# 1️⃣ Recode event variable: 1 = event, 0 = censored
lung$status <- ifelse(lung$status == 2, 1, 0)

# 2️⃣ Split into training and test sets
n <- nrow(lung)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = 0.7 * n)
train_data <- lung[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- lung[-train_idx, ]

# 3️⃣ Fit gradient boosting model (CoxPH loss)
gbm_model <- gbm(
  formula = Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex,
  data = train_data,
  distribution = "coxph",
  n.trees = 2000,
  interaction.depth = 3,
  shrinkage = 0.01,   # small learning rate
  bag.fraction = 0.8, # stochastic boosting
  train.fraction = 1.0,
  n.cores = 1,        # parallelization optional
  verbose = FALSE
)

# 4️⃣ Predict log-risk scores (linear predictor) on the test set
lp_gbm <- predict(gbm_model, newdata = test_data, n.trees = 2000, type = "link")

# 5️⃣ Compute concordance index on the test set
c_gbm <- concordance.index(
  x = lp_gbm,
  surv.time  = test_data$time,
  surv.event = test_data$status
)

c_gbm$c.index

```

xgboost
```{r}
library(survival)
library(xgboost)
library(survcomp)

set.seed(42)

# 1️⃣ Recode status: 1=censored, 2=event → 0=censored, 1=event
lung$status <- ifelse(lung$status == 2, 1, 0)

# 2️⃣ Train/test split
n <- nrow(lung)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = 0.7 * n)
train_data <- lung[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- lung[-train_idx, ]

# 3️⃣ Prepare matrices
x_train <- model.matrix(~ age + sex, data = train_data)[, -1]
x_test  <- model.matrix(~ age + sex, data = test_data)[, -1]

# 4️⃣ Create DMatrix — include survival time and event
#    XGBoost needs event = 1 for death, 0 for censor
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_train, label = train_data$time)
setinfo(dtrain, "label_lower_bound", train_data$time)
setinfo(dtrain, "label_upper_bound", train_data$time)
setinfo(dtrain, "weight", train_data$status)  # event indicator used as weight (0=censored)

# 5️⃣ Fit model
params <- list(
  objective = "survival:cox",
  eval_metric = "cox-nloglik",
  eta = 0.05,
  max_depth = 3
)

xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 300,
  verbose = 0
)

# 6️⃣ Predict on test set
lp_xgb <- predict(xgb_model, newdata = x_test)

# 7️⃣ Compute concordance index
c_xgb <- concordance.index(
  x = lp_xgb,
  surv.time  = test_data$time,
  surv.event = test_data$status
)

c_xgb$c.index
```


########################## CROSS VALIDATION CARET + C-Index

```{r}
library(survival)
library(randomForestSRC)
library(survcomp)

set.seed(42)

# 1️⃣ Prepare data
# Recode event: 1=censored, 2=event -> 0/1
lung$status <- ifelse(lung$status == 2, 1, 0)

# 2️⃣ Define CV parameters
K <- 5                                    # number of folds
n <- nrow(lung)
folds <- sample(rep(1:K, length.out = n)) # random fold assignment

cindex_values <- numeric(K)               # store C-index for each fold

# 3️⃣ Run K-fold cross-validation manually
for (k in 1:K) {
  cat("\nFold", k, "of", K, "\n")
  
  # Split data
  train_data <- lung[folds != k, ]
  test_data  <- lung[folds == k, ]
  
  # Fit RSF model
  rsf_model <- rfsrc(Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex + ph.ecog,
                     data = train_data,
                     ntree = 500,
                     na.action = "na.impute")
  
  # Predict on test data
  pred_test <- predict(rsf_model, newdata = test_data, na.action = "na.impute")
  
  # Extract risk scores (cumulative hazard at final time point)
  risk_test <- pred_test$chf
  if (is.matrix(risk_test)) {
    risk_test <- risk_test[, ncol(risk_test)]
  } else if (length(dim(risk_test)) == 3) {
    risk_test <- risk_test[, ncol(risk_test), "condCHF.1"]
  } else {
    risk_test <- as.numeric(risk_test)
  }
  
  # Compute C-index on this fold
  ci <- concordance.index(
    x = risk_test,
    surv.time  = test_data$time,
    surv.event = test_data$status
  )$c.index
  
  cindex_values[k] <- ci
  cat("Fold", k, "C-index:", round(ci, 3), "\n")
}

# 4️⃣ Average performance across folds
mean_cindex <- mean(cindex_values)
sd_cindex <- sd(cindex_values)

cat("\nAverage C-index across", K, "folds:", round(mean_cindex, 3),
    "(±", round(sd_cindex, 3), ")\n")

```
